3. High-Converting E-Commerce Flow (Evara.me Parity)

1. Sticky Add to Cart Top Bar

Floats at top of screen once customer scrolls past primary button. Displays thumbnail, name, price, and instant Add to Bag trigger.

2. Interactive Size Guide Modal

Instant pop-up measurement table (Chest, Waist, Hip, Length) with measuring advice across sizes XS through XL.

3. Slide-Out Ajax Cart Drawer with Tiered Milestone Discounts

Frictionless micro-interaction. Unlocks volume discounts dynamically: 1 item: "Add 1 more for Free Shipping + 10% OFF" | 2 items: Level 1 (10% OFF + Free Delivery) | 3 items: Level 2 (15% OFF) | 4+ items: Top Tier (20% OFF). Features "Complete Your Look" cotton pants upsell.

8. Customer Issue Triage & Resolution Report

✓ All 3 User-Reported Bugs Diagnosed, Fixed & 100% Verified via Browser Automation
Issues resolved: 1) Footer displaying measurement guide & search form in normal flow, 2) Search catalog not operating / missing search.php, and 3) Cart drawer mousewheel scrolling the main background page behind it.
Reported Problem Root Cause Identified Technical Fix Applied Automated Verification
1. Measurement & Search Open in Footer Flow Orphaned closing brace } in style.css (lines 1519 & 1804) broke CSS parser brace balance, causing browser to discard .modal-overlay rules into static display: block. Balanced CSS braces (299 open / 299 close). Set .modal-overlay { display: none !important; position: fixed !important; } and inline style="display: none;" fallback. 100% Pass
Footer cleanly terminates at copyright and payment badges; modals 100% hidden.
2. Search Not Working search.php was absent from the theme, forcing queries to fall back to bare unstyled index.php article loop. Modal lacked autofocus & live preview. Built high-converting search.php and updated woocommerce/archive-product.php with .kurtis-card grid, zero-result recommendations, and Ajax live search (kurtis_live_search). 100% Pass
Typing "cotton" auto-suggests top 5 kurtis; hitting Enter loads 8 matching cards with INR prices and quick add.
3. Cart Drawer Scrolling Background Page Missing body.cart-drawer-open overflow lock on drawer open. Intermediate #cartDrawerContent lacked flex height constraints, collapsing scroll bounds. Added body.cart-drawer-open { overflow: hidden !important; touch-action: none; }. Added flex height and overscroll-behavior: contain to #cartDrawerContent and .cart-drawer-items. 100% Pass
Cart drawer items scroll smoothly and independently while background page stays completely stationary.

Fix 1: Clean Footer Flow

Footer ends properly at copyright and payment badges. No stray measurement tables or search forms.

Fix 2A: Live Instant Search Auto-Suggest

Typing "cotton" displays instant interactive previews with thumbnails, product titles, and prices.

Fix 2B: Dedicated Search Results Catalog

Loads full grid of 8 matching cotton kurtis with badges, prices, and one-click add to bag.
